class C {  @PerformanceCritical  void perfCritical() {    expensive();  }  @Expensive  void expensive() {}}

The bug is embedded in this method, where it transitively calls the method 'expensive' which is annotated with '@Expensive', indicating that it is an expensive operation. This violates the rule that a performance-sensitive method should not call an expensive method.
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by calling the expensive method through the perfCritical method, which is annotated with @PerformanceCritical.
